episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: Dilini is accepted to the Colombo Medical Faculty; Nimal is proud, Kumari worries about the cost.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: Dilini gets ready to leave the village for medical school; Sahan does not want her to go.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Dilini's first weeks at medical school; she comes home for a weekend.

script.text: Morning light. A dog barks in the distance.
They look at each other in silence.
Morning light. A dog barks in the distance.
They look at each other in silence.
Morning light. A dog barks in the distance.
They look at each other in silence.
Dilini packs her anatomy textbooks into a cloth bag.
They look at each other in silence.
Dilini, home for a weekend, shows Sahan her first-week timetable from the medical faculty.
They look at each other in silence.
Dilini shows Sahan her acceptance letter from the Colombo Medical Faculty.
They look at each other in silence.
Nimal reads Dilini's medical faculty letter aloud to Kumari.
Nimal pins the letter to the verandah wall.
Morning light. A dog barks in the distance.
They look at each other in silence.
Morning light. A dog barks in the distance.
They look at each other in silence.
Morning light. A dog barks in the distance.
They look at each other in silence.
Morning light. A dog barks in the distance.
They look at each other in silence.
Sahan gives Dilini a stethoscope wrapped in newspaper.
Dilini holds it without a word.

card.summary: Dilini's father, 52. Proud of her place at the medical faculty.
Dilini's mother, 48. Worries about paying for medical school.
Dilini's friend from the village tea shop, 24. Does not want her to leave.
Nimal and Kumari's daughter, 21. Accepted to the Colombo Medical Faculty (E1S2); leaves the village for medical school in episode 2. Wears a saree.
